title: Guidelines on Digital Lending
summary: Regulatory framework for digital lending operations covering Lending Service Providers (LSPs), Digital Lending Apps (DLAs), direct disbursement to borrower bank accounts, data privacy, and mandatory KFS.

clauses.title: Direct Account-to-Account Disbursement
clauses.text: All loan disbursements and repayments must be executed directly between the bank account of the Regulated Entity (RE) and the borrower, without any pass-through account or pool account of any third-party Lending Service Provider (LSP).
key_takeaways: No fintech intermediary holding pools allowed

clauses.title: Restricted Mobile Permissions
clauses.text: Digital Lending Apps (DLAs) shall not access mobile phone resources such as contact lists, call logs, SMS logs, or biometric data. Only one-time access for camera/microphone for KYC purpose is permissible with explicit prior consent.
key_takeaways: No contact list scraping for harassment
No continuous location tracking or file system access

clauses.title: Exit Option in Digital Loans
clauses.text: Borrowers must be provided an explicit cooling-off window within the app to exit digital credit agreements without incurring any penal charges, ensuring protection against hurried impulse borrowing.
key_takeaways: Must be prominently visible in app UI
